Title: Validation error: contextRef missing
Content: User encountered error: 'Facts must have a valid contextRef'. Root Cause: Missing or invalid context assignment. Resolution Steps: 1) Open the Fact properties panel. 2) Check if a contextRef exists for the fact. 3) Ensure the context period matches the taxonomy requirement. 4) Regenerate the context list if corrupted. 5) Reapply contextRef and validate again.

Title: Calculation inconsistency for total revenue
Content: XBRL validation reports: 'Inconsistency found in calculation linkbase: total revenue does not match sum of children'. Root Cause: Incorrect sign or missing contributing fact. Resolution Steps: 1) Identify parent element. 2) Verify summation relationships. 3) Check for negative weights. 4) Correct incorrect tagging for revenue children elements.

Title: Dimension default member missing
Content: Validation shows: 'Required default member for dimension ProductAxis not found'. Root Cause: Missing default member in instance. Resolution Steps: 1) Open Dimensions panel. 2) Select ProductAxis. 3) Assign default member as per taxonomy. 4) Revalidate.

Title: Incorrect taxonomy version used
Content: User tagged document with wrong taxonomy version. Resolution Steps: 1) Open Taxonomy Manager. 2) Confirm correct taxonomy version for current filing. 3) Retag impacted facts. 4) Regenerate instance.

Title: Label linkbase mismatch
Content: Error: 'Label role does not match expected role for element'. Root Cause: Wrong label assignment. Steps: 1) Check label definitions. 2) Assign correct role (e.g., verbose, terse). 3) Refresh linkbase.

Title: Fact value datatype incorrect
Content: Validation error: 'Invalid fact value type: expected decimal'. Root Cause: User entered string for numeric fact. Resolution Steps: 1) Validate element datatype in taxonomy. 2) Correct user input. 3) Revalidate.

Title: Rendering issue in iXBRL viewer
Content: Page 4 tables not rendering in the Inline Viewer. Cause: Missing presentation linkbase or hidden elements. Resolution Steps: 1) Inspect presentation tree. 2) Ensure required hidden facts exist. 3) Rebuild viewer output.

Title: UnitRef missing for monetary fact
Content: Validation error: 'Fact requires a valid unitRef'. Resolution Steps: 1) Open Unit Manager. 2) Create or select correct unit (currency). 3) Apply to fact. 4) Validate.

Title: Duplicate facts warning
Content: Error: 'Duplicate facts detected for the same contextRef and unitRef'. Resolution: 1) Identify duplicate facts. 2) Remove or merge according to taxonomy rules. 3) Validate.

Title: Missing required element for filing
Content: Validation error: 'Required element DocumentType missing'. Root Cause: mandatory element missing. Steps: 1) Search for DocumentType in taxonomy. 2) Tag required section. 3) Validate again.
